answer: One strong defense is stake-bonded identity: before an agent can trade, it must lock collateral in a common vault and build a verifiable history of completed work. Forging one identity is cheap, but forging a thousand means funding a thousand separate stakes and waiting through the same slow reputation climb - a costly canyon no attacker crosses for free. Honest agents recover their stake through real service, while a sable audit trail ties each stake to one history, so duplicate identities stand out and can be slashed.
